Galileo | 1989-10-18 | 1989-084B | 2560 kg

Lightest: Pioneer 10

Notes on the evidence:
- Pioneer 10's pinned page is in front of me now, with "Launch mass 258 kg" in the infobox. Its launch date reads March 3, 1972 (01:49:04 UTC in the pinned text).
- The New Horizons pinned page has a labelled "Launch mass" of 478 kg (1,054 lb). The current live page shows only "Dry mass" (401 kg), so the pinned value is the one I used.
- Pioneer 11 (258.5 kg) is only 0.5 kg heavier than Pioneer 10, so the lightest call rests on that small margin.
- Cassini's mass is given as 5,712 kg, shown ungrouped as 5712 per your format.
- I did not log in, buy anything, or enter any personal information.
